description: Land Acquisition - Karavita, Nivithigala D/S Division, Ratnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire a specific parcel of land (0.0506 Hectare, Lot No. 2197) for public purpose. It provides detailed land description, location details, and procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. The content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
